permissions.description: Seal an approved publication or archive delivery visibility.
constraints: Human accountable principal and approval digest required.

permissions.description: Preview allowed draft content in an isolated audience context.
constraints: No official participation or assessment mutations.

permissions.description: Adopt authorized reusable definitions into an editable target.
constraints: Requires source consumption rights and destination edit right.

permissions.description: Configure managed templates and approve field-level changes.
constraints: Protected overrides require a reviewed reason.

permissions.description: Upload, describe and nominate approved assets.
constraints: Upload quota, scanner and source rights rules apply.

permissions.description: Withdraw unsafe or unauthorized assets from delivery.
constraints: Record reason and affected dependency impact.

permissions.description: Reserve and prepare an approved scoped authoring document.
constraints: Current upload and source scope. No independent rights grant or publication capability.

permissions.description: Read authorized extraction and authoring-run metadata and protected derivation locators.
constraints: Active source attestation and recipient authorization. Answer key paths require separate Assessment permission.

permissions.description: Approve bounded authoring source purposes and disclosure under reviewed rights evidence.
constraints: Human authority and protected evidence. No self-grant to source worker or authoring agent.

permissions.description: Stage source-grounded curriculum candidates and record verified job receipts.
constraints: Dedicated workers use explicit service-principal grant, current rights and lease. Scope excludes published or learner records.

permissions.description: Review exact extraction and authoring plans and authorize a selected staged apply.
constraints: Human independent reviewer by default. Item/marking and course publication authority remain separate.

scenarios.title: Publication rejects stale independent review
given: Draft revision 7 approved with digest A.
when: Edit a caption to revision 8.
Attempt publish with revision 7 and digest A.
then: 409 DRAFT_CHANGED.
No publication or published event.

scenarios.title: Duplicate creates independent learning occurrences
given: Parent has lessons A and B. A has one resource R.
when: Duplicate A.
Move its copy ahead of A.
then: Copy and copied child receive two new keys.
Original and copy share allowed resource revision and retain independent progress.

scenarios.title: Three-way propagation preserves local text
given: Base core text A and no note.
Source changes core to B. Target adds note N.
when: Preview and apply approved merge.
then: Core B and note N appear.
Publication remains at prior version until separately approved.

scenarios.title: Protected concurrent edits require a decision
given: Same protected path has values A, B and C in baseline, source and destination.
when: Preview merge.
then: One unresolved conflict, no draft change.

scenarios.title: Type mismatch stays quarantined
given: Declared image/png upload contains HTML.
when: Finalize exact bytes and scan.
then: State rejected and no approved rendition or learner URL.

scenarios.title: Durable publication retry returns same version
given: Manifest and database transaction committed but client timed out.
when: Retry with same idempotency key.
then: Original course version ID and digest returned, one published event.

scenarios.title: Unresolvable prerequisite blocks publication
given: A requires B completed. B requires A completed.
when: Validate draft.
then: Report OUTLINE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with both affected stable keys.

scenarios.title: Preview never creates an attempt
given: Exam draft accessible to author.
when: Start simulated learner preview and operate exam controls.
then: UI is explicitly a preview. No official attempt or progress record.

scenarios.title: Catalog code normalization and metadata compare-and-swap
given: Unit M is in institution S. Existing catalog code ALG.
when: Create ALG-2, update its title from Algebra II to Intermediate Algebra at revision 1, try stale update at revision 1, and archive at revision 2.
Try to create alg under the same institution.
then: ALG-2 revisions 1, 2 and 3 are visible to authorized staff. Stale update fails. Case-folded ALG collision returns 409 COURSE_CODE_EXISTS.

scenarios.title: Publish independent reviewed draft and read exact manifest
given: A course has no prior version, a reviewer separate from its author and a published assessment definition.
when: Create blank draft, create lesson definition and quiz activity, then seal edits and an acknowledgment rule.
Insert exact versions, validate, submit digest and receive independent approval. Publish then read the exact manifest.
Archive the publication with active uses acknowledged.
then: Version 1 reflects the approved content and exact assessment binding. Archived version retains readable authorized manifest and cannot be selected as new default.

scenarios.title: Author withdraws an abandoned fork
given: Course has publication version 2 and active learners.
when: Fork a draft from version 2, then abandon it with reason obsolete proposal.
then: Fork has matching stable placement keys. Abandon changes only the fork and leaves version 2 and learner records intact.

scenarios.title: Library linked adoption and independent detachment
given: Institution S licenses its fractions explainer for independent copy within S.
when: Create library STEM. Publish FRACTIONS revision 1. Adopt linked into lesson L and detach after correcting attribution.
then: The independent definition receives a new logical identity. Provenance retains source revision 1 and linked updates no longer target the detached placement.

scenarios.title: Asset permission and emergency withdrawal lifecycle
given: A 4096-byte approved media upload belongs to a shared lesson. The exact digest is later identified as compromised.
when: Allocate one-use upload, receive and scan exact bytes, publish a reference, then withdraw under authorized reason.
then: Quarantined bytes are inaccessible until approval. Withdrawal denies subsequent authorized delivery while immutable published references and source evidence survive.

scenarios.title: Hosted media requires a pinned provider revision
given: A teacher has an approved institutional media connection and rights to media key video-11.
when: Reserve hosted asset. Try approval when provider reports a moving latest alias. Resolve provider version media-v2-20261110 and retry through the authorized map.
then: Alias fails REMOTE_ASSET_UNPINNED. Immutable provider revision links through ExternalResourceMap. AssetVersion contains no raw remote URL or managed bytes pointer.

scenarios.title: Protected source intake remains distinct from learner PDF
given: Scoped author uploads a 28000-byte PDF and Platform verifies a managed evidence-purpose StorageObject.
when: Request private extraction and adaptation, with no learner download or remote provider permission. Queue physical pages 0 and 1. Attempt to bind the original AssetVersion in learner delivery.
then: Authorized extraction accepted. Learner placement validation rejects evidence-purpose asset. Distribution requires a separate content-purpose version and rights.

scenarios.title: Rotated PDF page evidence is exact and repeatable
given: One selected page with crop [10,20,210,120], user unit 1 and clockwise rotation 90 degrees.
when: Fenced page worker submits source box [30,50,70,70] twice with same digest. Independent reviewer accepts exact recognized region and seals. Staff read region then open authorized evidence.
then: One accepted receipt and region set. Canonical upright bounds [30000,20000,50000,60000]. Safe summary excludes raw source. Unauthorized caller gets generic unavailable.

scenarios.title: Sealed source correction preserves old lineage
given: Prior exact source evidence mistook − for a hyphen. A candidate points to prior sealed region.
when: Start correction run with exact predecessor and revised review manifest. Commit corrected page and seal.
then: New run and corrected region have new identities. Earlier source reference and affected candidate remain auditable. Changed claim requires renewed review.

scenarios.title: Authoring workflow applies a reviewed complete subset
given: Exact draft revision 7 and approved source state. One exercise contains enough input, another is missing its rate.
when: Start run, seal staged candidates and exact protected lineage. Independent reviewer selects dependency-closed complete subset. Apply at expected revision 7 and reconcile owner receipts.
then: The complete item and linked lesson become authorized draft changes. Missing-rate item remains blocked. Source answer metadata stays staff-only. No publication or offering activation.

scenarios.title: Stale stage and cancellation do not overwrite owner history
given: Worker effect A committed a draft change, lost acknowledgement and lease expired. Later worker observes receipt.
when: Retry A with old fence. Cancel future effects. Read current owner receipt and run history.
then: Old worker fails AUTHORING_FENCE_EXPIRED. Existing effect reconciles once. Run canceled, prior authorized draft output preserved.

scenarios.title: Provider rights are checked before page dispatch
given: Human approved private_extract for selected region and no external_process. A worker requests hosted OCR.
when: Attempt hosted extraction then switch to approved local isolated profile.
then: Hosted request denied before sending bytes. Local can proceed. A page with mixed answer and teaching regions is shown only to an authorized reviewer or redacted crop view.
